document_title: How to create workflows for business spaces
content:
- What information is required to complete the process? For example, is there a request form? Are there designs or assets involved? What is the final output?
- What restrictions do there need to be to ensure that the process is followed? For example, can some steps only be done by some people? Who are the approvers?
Low-tech tip: use a whiteboard to create a flow diagram that everyone can see and agree on.
Create a new workflow
If there isn't an existing workflow to meet your needs, you can create a new one to use with your space.
- Select Settings (), then Work items.
- Select Workflows, then Add workflow.
- Do both of the following until you've built your workflow: 
  - Select Add status to add a new step to the workflow (you can add existing statuses or create new ones)
  - Select Add transition or drag from a node on one status to another to add a transition
- Select Publish Draft.
- Select the new workflow to use in your space: 
  - Select a business space that you wish to update the workflow for.
  - Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings.
  - Select Workflows from the sidebar.
  - Select Edit workflow.
  - Select your new workflow, then Next.
  - Choose the work types that will use this workflow and select Finish.
  - Select Publish and Associate to migrate any existing work items to the new statuses in your workflow.
To change to a different initial status (the first one after the circle), click the transition line then drag the arrow from the existing initial status to your new one.
